successors.name: Kingdom of Poland
successors.text: the Duchy of Łęczyca, later the Łęczyca Voivodeship

ledger.x: c. 1231: Konrad I of Masovia creates the Duchy of Łęczyca. 'The Duchy of Łęczyca was created around 1231 from the Province of Łęczyca, which was part of the Seniorate Province'; infobox 'Established: 1231', map caption 'Łęczyca Province replaced in 1231 by the Duchy of Łęczyca'. The page says 'around', so the year is…
1352: 'After his death in 1352 the duchy became part of the Kingdom of Poland.'
1352: the Duchy of Łęczyca ends with the death of its last duke; the Łęczyca Voivodeship succeeds it.

certainty.note: The page gives no boundary; the duchy is known as the later Łęczyca Voivodeship.
